sourceMarkup: {{CurrencyInfobox |title = Gem |image = GemV3.png |type = Evergreen }} ==Description== '''Gems''' are a rewardable currency that is mainly rewarded after completing a [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore mode]] match, [[Hidden Wave]] match, [[Polluted Wasteland II]] match, [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode match and formerly, triumphing [[Challenge Maps]]. They have less utility than {{Coins|Coins}} and are used to purchase some towers and cosmetics. Similar to {{Coins|Coins}}, in the [[Robux Shop]], you can also buy '''Gems''' with {{Robux|Robux}}. It takes the appearance of a purple hexagon gem. Previously, it was a square gem instead. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Versions}} GemV1.png|Original '''Gem''' icon (Hardcore Testing).
